method.groups: curators of vaults that exited before t0 or entered after are in neither group; both groups need at least 1000000 USD of segment AUM at t0
method.log_variants: log(end / start) with the end floored at 1 percent of the start
method.other_vaults_change: same, without the vaults listed as exposed in the event (spillover to the curator's other vaults)
method.pooled: OLS of the change (relative change: top 1 percent clipped) on an exposed dummy with event fixed effects, CR1 errors clustered by curator; permutation p shuffling the exposed label within events; only events with both groups
method.segment_change: net USD (E3 aum minus holdings of other counted vaults) of the curator's vaults in the segment, day before t0 to 90 days later, minus 1

what: AUM change over the 90 days after t0 for curators exposed at t0 (third-party vaults present at t0) against curators not exposed, on the same protocols and loan asset symbols as the event's affected markets; pooled with event fixed effects
